projects.title: Electronic Business Permits & Licensing System
projects.tagline: A full-stack government platform for business permit applications, assessments, payments, and digital document processing.

overview.problem: Traditional business permit processing can involve multiple offices, manual document handling, and fragmented application tracking.
overview.solution: eBPLS is a full-stack government platform designed to digitize business permit applications, assessments, payments, and document processing.
overview.role: Designed and developed a role-based system with dedicated portals for applicants and municipal offices, integrating workflow management, document generation, and payment processing.

challenges.problem: Managing complex workflows involving multiple departments and approval stages.
challenges.solution: Implemented a backend-enforced state machine to validate application status transitions and ensure process integrity.

challenges.problem: Securely processing and verifying online payments.
challenges.solution: Integrated PayMongo webhooks with HMAC verification and idempotency controls to prevent duplicate transaction processing.

challenges.problem: Managing document uploads securely and efficiently.
challenges.solution: Utilized Supabase Storage with strict RLS policies to ensure that only authorized personnel can access sensitive business documents.

learnings.title: Backend Architecture
learnings.description: Designing APIs around business rules and workflow states.

learnings.title: System Integrity
learnings.description: Validating payment events and preventing duplicate processing.

learnings.title: Role-Based Systems
learnings.description: Managing complex permissions and data access across multiple municipal departments.

projects.unavailable_reason: Source code is private. Live demonstration is available.

projects.title: HanapMedisina
projects.tagline: An offline-first AI-powered mobile app that identifies Philippine medicinal plants using on-device machine learning.

overview.problem: People in remote areas need reliable medicinal plant identification, but often lack internet connectivity to access online AI tools.
overview.solution: HanapMedisina is a mobile app that brings powerful plant identification directly to the device using an offline-first TensorFlow Lite model.
overview.role: Developed the React Native application, integrated the on-device ML model, and built the offline persistence layer for plant data and user history.

items: Offline-first architecture with zero cloud dependencies
Local plant database and educational content
Import and export of scan history data

challenges.problem: Running machine learning inference efficiently on mobile devices without internet access.
challenges.solution: Integrated TensorFlow Lite with React Native and optimized model loading and prediction workflows for on-device classification.

challenges.problem: Providing a complete user experience without relying on cloud services.
challenges.solution: Implemented an offline-first architecture using local JSON data, AsyncStorage persistence, and bundled application assets.

challenges.problem: Maintaining high camera performance during continuous scanning.
challenges.solution: Utilized react-native-vision-camera's frame processors to run real-time inference without blocking the main UI thread.

learnings.title: On-Device ML
learnings.description: Learned how to deploy and optimize TensorFlow Lite models for offline mobile environments.

learnings.title: Offline-First Architecture
learnings.description: Gained experience in designing robust local data structures and sync strategies for apps with no connectivity.

learnings.title: React Native Performance
learnings.description: Mastered techniques for keeping the UI thread responsive during heavy computational tasks like image processing.

projects.unavailable_reason: Mobile application. Source code is available, but no public web deployment is available.
